serving.text_only_input_quote: question = "If you had a time machine, but could only go to the past or the future once and never return, which would you choose and why?"
serving.notes: chat_template.jinja inserts a system turn only when the first message has role system. It has no default system sentence. If enable_thinking is false, the generation prompt adds an empty <think></think> block. max_new_tokens 128 is only in the card's quick start. generation_config.json sets do_sample true, temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, and no repetition_penalty. config.json sets max_position_embeddings to 40960. The repository has two safetensors shards and no adapter_config.json. trainer_state.json sets num_train_epochs to 1 and stops at global_step 1904, epoch 0.4998933394594772. The learning_rate field is the peak logged value, at step 195. train_batch_size is 4. Logged reward names are format_reward, mcq_accuracy_reward, and tag_count_reward. The Weights & Biases run page was not retrieved. A Featherless hosting page adds a medical-exam purpose the card does not state and expands GRPO incorrectly; that page is not used for the purpose, audience, or function fields.
